caseno: Appeal from Original Decree No. 45 of 1977.
lawyer:
Shawkat Ali Khan with Abdul Baset Majumder ----- For the appellants. 
M.A. Mannan ----- For the respondents
parties:
Amiren Nessa and another ----- Appellant
vs.
Harun Mia and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: "The plaintiffs are out of possession of the disputed properties and as such this suit for simple partition without prayer for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of their share and without payment of ad valorem court fee is not maintainable." The learned Subordinate Judge was further of the view that the plaintiffs were not in actual possession of the suit land. Reliance was made by the learned Subordinate Judge in the case of Ajiruddin Vs Rahman Fakir 13 DLR (S.C.) page 191.
